Removes the despawn in game hours system for airdrops.
Disables the despawn all airdrops system when the server/game start.

If enabled - the crate lands exactly on the coordinates from the table, instead of a random spot inside the drop zone. Useful if you cleared a landing pad near your base.
Does not affect drops spawned near the player - those coordinates are random by design.

Only used when Exact Drop Coordinates is enabled. If the exact tile is occupied by a tree, a vehicle, water or a building, the mod looks for a free tile within this radius.
0 means the exact tile only - if it is busy, no crate spawns.
Power of the removal effect (1 = normal, 200 = maximum). Affects quantity and radius of spawned effects.

Effect when airdrop is automatically removed:
• None - no effect
• Explosion - explosion with sound
• Zombies - spawn zombies around
• Animals - spawn aggressive animals
Chance to spawn any airdrop every in game hour. Spawns only once a day.
Rate limit: 1 = at most once per hour, 24 = once per day.
Probability (percent) that the airdrop will spawn near the player instead of default locations.
Maximum distance (in tiles) from the player to spawn the airdrop.
Minimal distance (in tiles) from the player to spawn the airdrop.
If enabled, the airdrop may spawn near the player at random coordinates within specified radius.

Multiplier for changing the interval between airdrops. 0 = no progression, positive values = less frequent over time, negative = more frequent. Range: -5.0 to +5.0. Limits: minimum 1 hour, maximum 1 year.
In game hours until airdrop despawn

This is the most performance important variable, impacts in how many ticks the server will WAIT to check player in area to spawn/olddespawn the airdrop (the airdrop doesnt spawn if player is not rendering it).

If enabled - mod will use default coordinates table;
If disabled - it will use AirdropPosition.ini in lua folder of Zomboid.
How to make custom spawn locations - read in mod description.

If enabled - mod will use built-in presets that can be selected below.
If disabled - it will use AirdropLootTable.ini in lua folder of Zomboid.
How to make custom loot table - read in mod description.

Visual effect at the drop site:
• None - no effect
• Fire - fire with lighting (2 hours)
• Smoke - smoke without lighting (2 hours)
• Smoke + Fire - both effects

Warning: Smoke may not work correctly in Build 42
If enabled, draw a highlighted area around the landing site.
Show exact drop point on map
If enabled, draw a marker at the precise landing point.
Multiplier for the quantity of items in airdrops (0.1 to 10.0, default 1.0). Affects both the number of items and their quantities.

Enables radio beacon that beeps when player is near active airdrop.
Beep frequency increases as player gets closer.

Fixed radio frequency (88000-108000 kHz).
Only if Random Frequency is disabled.

Radio broadcasts on random frequency 88-108 MHz.
If disabled, uses fixed frequency.
